language.label: Language
language.hint: Display language for on-screen text such as menus and buttons.

worklog.title: Work log
worklog.scopeHint: When set to ‘Mine only’, only status changes and ‘auto-fill in-progress’ for tasks/issues assigned to your configured name are written to the log.
worklog.weeklyModeHint: How the weekly log renders on the integrated monitoring ‘Logs’ tab. ‘Weekly final state’ merges all days into a final state per task.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.customColorsHint: Set the 12 core colors and the rest (surface steps, muted, soft backgrounds, focus ring, etc.) are derived automatically.

brand.title: Brand
brand.wordmarkHint: Sidebar logo. Split into two parts shown in different colors. (Collapsed sidebar shows each first letter.)
brand.windowTitleHint: Used as the browser tab and desktop app window title. (Applied on save.)
brand.appIconHint: Used as the running taskbar/window icon. Small PNG/ICO recommended (SVG unsupported). The exe's own icon and the pinned taskbar icon don't change.
brand.iconTooBig: Icon is large (>256KB). A small PNG/ICO is recommended.

markdown.title: Markdown viewer
markdown.fontSizeHint: Applied instantly to markdown rendering (meetings, work log, WBS details, etc.).
markdown.sample:
# Meeting sample

This paragraph previews the **current font size** and *line height*. Use the sliders to tune body readability for your screen distance and resolution.

- First item — a decision or note.
- Second item — includes `inline code` too.

behavior.title: Defaults
behavior.defaultAuthorPlaceholder: Name pre-filled in change log, meetings, etc.
behavior.defaultAuthorHint: This name becomes "me". When you leave the field, a resource with the same name is found or created and linked for the TODO (My work) view.
behavior.defaultTaskViewHint: The view shown by default when opening the Tasks tab.
behavior.integratedMenuModeHint: How the integrated (global) menu on the left of the sidebar expands.
behavior.shortcutsHelpHint: Can also be opened with the ? key on any page.
behavior.aiWarnBold: Using this may incur additional charges.
behavior.aiWarnText: Summaries consume your Claude subscription / API usage.
behavior.aiCliDesc: Calls the locally installed claude CLI via claude -p (print mode, prompt passed on stdin) to generate summaries. The CLI must be installed and logged in.
behavior.aiButtonHint: Shows a button on the meeting form that summarizes the discussion with claude.
behavior.connTestHint: Calls the claude CLI once to check install, auth, and response.
behavior.claudeTestFailed: Claude CLI test failed — check backend / CLI install

system.clientDataText: In Client mode the data folder is managed by the server. Edit dataFolder in the server's %LOCALAPPDATA%\Atlas\config.json to change it.

about.title: About
about.eulaHint: You may use this app for personal and commercial (business) purposes. Shows the full terms.
about.licensesHint: Atlas is built with the open-source components below. Their copyright and license notices are shown here.

backup.title: Settings backup
backup.locationHint: App settings (appearance, brand, icons, AI toggle, etc.) are stored in the browser localStorage key pm-hub-settings.
backup.storageNote: In the desktop app this value lives in a binary LevelDB inside %LOCALAPPDATA%\Atlas\WebView2\, so it isn't visible as a file in Explorer. %LOCALAPPDATA%\Atlas\config.json holds only connection/data-folder settings; the actual DB and attachments are in the data folder (e.g. Documents\ProjectManager\). Use Export below to back up or migrate settings to a file.
backup.importFailed: Import failed — check that it's a valid atlas-settings.json.
backup.resetHint: Theme, custom colors, brand, icons, last selected project, etc. return to defaults. (Does not affect DB data.)

reset.title: Reset settings
reset.message: Returns all settings to their initial state. Theme, custom colors, brand, icons, author name, last project, etc. will be lost.

icons.title: Icons
icons.menuHint: Sidebar navigation icons. Click to replace.
icons.entityHint: Item-type icons in the activity feed and search results.

autobackup.title: Auto backup
autobackup.enableHint: Periodically exports all data (DB + attachments) to the chosen folder. If that folder is a sync folder like OneDrive/Dropbox, it's uploaded to the cloud automatically.
autobackup.folderHint: Cannot be inside the data folder (avoids recursion). A cloud sync folder is recommended.
autobackup.statusHint: Restore: unzip and overwrite the data folder (app closed), or use per-project Import.

update.title: Update
update.managedText: The Microsoft Store version downloads and installs new versions automatically. No manual check needed.
update.sessionsWarn: ⚠ {{count}} running Claude session(s) — will be closed on install.
update.autoCheckHint: Periodically checks for new versions in the background. Download/install are never automatic.
update.launchConfirm: Running the installer will close Atlas and install the new version. Proceed?
update.launchConfirmSessions: Running the installer will close the running Atlas and all {{count}} connected Claude (MCP/CLI) session(s). Proceed?

conn.title: Connection mode
conn.bridgeOnly: Can only be changed in the desktop app. The browser (dev) runs in Local mode.
conn.modeHint: Local runs in-process inside Atlas.exe. Client connects to a remote Atlas-Server.
conn.localDesc: Stores directly in this machine's SQLite file. Single user.
conn.clientDesc: Share with teammates. Atlas-Server must be running on the server machine.
conn.serverUrlHint: e.g. http://atlas.intranet:5200 (assumes plain HTTP on the intranet LAN)
conn.apiKeyHint: Shared secret from the server operator (X-Atlas-Key header). Leave empty to send nothing.

data.title: Data
data.locationHint: The folder where the database (projectmanager.db) and per-project attachments are stored. Changes apply after restarting Atlas.
data.desktopOnly: Changeable only in the desktop app
data.notExist: This folder doesn't exist yet. It will be created automatically on save.
data.noExistingDb: This folder has no existing Atlas data. Proceeding starts a new empty database. To move existing data, first copy the current folder's projectmanager.db and project subfolders here, then change.
data.foundDb: Found existing Atlas data in this folder{{suffix}}. Switching to use this data.
data.notWritable: No write permission — this folder can't be used.
